_about: PONY FAMILIES (director 2026-11-14, names, colours and virtues his; diary/DECISIONS_SEA.md): every pony gun belongs to one family: its skin's colours (game/pony_skin.gd: hue = the middle of its colours 0..1, span = how far they swing, sat = how strong) and ONE of its two traits comes from the family's own pony-only traits (data/gun_traits.json, field family), which play the family's virtue and its use for the party; the other trait is from the common pool. virtue / role are shown on the gun card. Trait numbers are my placeholders. short = the word the gun's name carries ("*PONY* Bellegrace ..."); the card shows the full name.

concordia.name: Concordia Starweave
concordia.role: Brings the party together: gun skills come round faster and hit harder

hearthgold.name: Hearthgold Trueheart
hearthgold.role: The steady one: honest damage every shot and warmth after every kill

valor.name: Valor Skystreak
valor.role: Stands at the front and never backs down

bellegrace.name: Bellegrace Gemshine
bellegrace.role: Precise and giving: crystal crits and full magazines for every gun

kindlebloom.name: Kindlebloom Softwing
kindlebloom.role: Calms the fight and lets the party flourish: softer blows, healing flowers

merribelle.name: Merribelle Joyburst
merribelle.role: Keeps the party going: confetti, laughing fits and a faster trigger
